Hogwire_height.comment: Straight leg of each arch: what is left of one panel after the semicircular top

Board_Thickness.comment: Actual thickness of 2x lumber (reference; sketches drawn at 1.5 in)

Board_Width.comment: Actual face width of one course: 7.25 = 2x8, 9.25 = 2x10, 5.5 = 2x6

Courses.comment: Number of stacked board courses per bed (bed height = Courses * Board_Width)

Post_Size.comment: 2x4 posts are 1.5 x 3.5 in; value is reference only

Mid_Post_Length.comment: Total length of each mid-span 2x4 post: Courses * Board_Width above grade, the rest driven into the ground

Trellis_Post_Length.comment: Total length of each 2x4 trellis post (the inside corner post under each arch, uncut 8 ft stick): Trellis_Post_Embed in the ground, the rest above grade

Trellis_Post_Embed.comment: How deep each 8 ft trellis post is set; 20 in puts its top 4 in above where the panel crosses it

Stake_Above_Sill.comment: Height of each arch-foot stake above the sill it is screwed to; the rest of the Mid_Post_Length stake is in the ground

Hoop_Count.comment: Number of low-tunnel hoops over Bed C (14 ft)

Hoop_Pitch.comment: Spacing of the hoops along Bed C: 5 x 31 in = 155 in, so the first and last hoops sit 5 in inside the end boards of the 168 in bed

components.name: Hogwire Arches

components.name: Bed A - 10 ft

Side boards full length outside, end boards 48 in between them, 4 corner 2x4 posts + 4 mid-span 2x4 posts (3.5 in face flat against the side boards, Mid_Post_Length long, driven into the ground). Replaces massing body "4th Bed". The NE corner post (walkway side, near end) is the 8 ft trellis post under Arch AB; a sill + 2 stakes at the bed centreline anchor the arch foot.

components.name: Bed B - 12 ft

components.name: Bed C - 14 ft
components.description: Bed C: 51 x 168 in outside (14 ft), inside 48 x 165 in. Side walls are two 8 ft boards per course (course 1: 96 + 72 in / course 2: 72 + 96 in) joined over 2x8 joint posts; end boards 48 in between them. 4 corner 2x4 posts + 4 mid-span 2x4 posts (3.5 in face flat against the side boards, Mid_Post_Length long, driven into the ground) + 4 2x8 joint posts (7.25 in face flat against the inside of the wall behind each seam, same length as a mid-span post). components.name: Bed Lumber
